judged_text: The handler fetches videoCallReference into evt.videoCallData but only calls updateCalendarAttendees — the new guests are never added to the actual video conference (Zoom/Google Meet) and no video link email section is verified for them. New guests receive an .ics with the meeting URL but are not registered as meeting participants on platforms that require per-attendee registration, so they cannot join or appear in host rosters; this gap is unaddressed by any section of the diff.
